Round 377 passes: `taskStatus` is PASS, I found no bugs, and the real-browser checks ran at both viewports (`browserVerified` and `realVerified` are true). I did not edit app source. The source status at the end matched the start: 6 modified files plus doc 243. The frozen-file and protected-file checks both came back clean.

- **Unit and mutants:** the 140 covering files pass (2,201 tests), and render-budget plus self-disabling-focus pass 41/41 under shuffle seed 42. All 11 mutants fail the tests as they should, run one at a time on a copy of A's tree. Three of them (`MU-T-ACTIONS-FRESH`, `MU-T-EXPORT-INLINE`, `MU-T-VIEW-NO-MEMO`) also trip the new `RB-LEAF4b` row, which the task allows. `MU-T-UNDO-FRESH-PER-EDIT` fails `RB-LEAF4b` only.
- **Performance:** both specs pass on a production build, run alone. The 189 deterministic count rows in the interactions spec match the round-375 sketch exactly. Only the 75 wall-clock rows varied, and I did not compare those.
- **Browser, 1440×900 and 1280×720:**
  - **Compared with HEAD (`6b11be7`):** the leaf probe, transport rows, studio smoke test and the new `RB-LEAF4b` check all match, apart from a 9 ms playback-position jitter. `RB-LEAF4b` means clicking Master Mute twice leaves the same Undo title and text both times.
  - **Auth:** a fresh anonymous context opens `/studio-lab` with no credentials. `/studio/middle-east` shows "Sign in required" with no workspace and no audio. `/api/studio-token` returns 401 with no token in the body, so premium auth is not bypassed.
- **Docs:** line 4 of doc 243 is exact, the headings are in order, and every id the doc names exists.

Things to know:
- **Fit ring:** after a mouse click path focus lands on Fit but no ring shows, on A and on HEAD alike. That follows the focus-visible-only rule. With the keyboard the ring is 1px brass at 2px offset, also identical. The row's "visible ring" wording asks for a ring on a click path the project rule forbids, so B may want to reword it.
- **Blocked:** the fake-bearer 500 check is blocked because the backend is unavailable in the cloud, and I didn't attempt it this round. The full vitest, typecheck, build, Biome, verify and e2e smoke rows are left to the root gate and not claimed as passed.
- **Log artifacts:** the `restore-check rc 1` line in the mutant log is a script path quirk, not a dirty tree. The first leaf-probe attempt died at my own 110 s wrapper and one replacement ran clean.

The L57 checker exits 0, with only `chainHeadGateRunGreen` null.
